artifact.title: Jobs to be done and opportunity map
artifact.question: What are auditors trying to get done, which opportunities follow from the findings and what did we cut for MVP and why?
artifact.iDecided: the outcome statement, the cut line for MVP and Test of Details as the anchor workflow.
artifact.weBuilt: the job statements from the coded material, the tree in two working sessions with PMs and the feasibility ratings with the engineering leads. Design team of three at this phase.

label: Reconstructed. Value and feasibility ratings are my judgment under the constraints in 01, argued with PMs and engineering leads and recorded in half points. They are not measured. Value drew the MVP line; feasibility set the sequence.
outcome: Auditors conclude faster with a file that stands up to inspection, and they stay accountable for every conclusion.

jobs.when: I am tracing a sample late in a long session
jobs.want: to compare the record to the document without re-finding the field each time
jobs.so: I finish the sample without errors creeping in

jobs.when: a document comes back partial or illegible
jobs.want: to flag it and move on without losing my place
jobs.so: the request goes out and the trace resumes later

jobs.when: I plan a Test of Details for an area
jobs.want: a structure that fits the procedure without editing it
jobs.so: the reviewer accepts the format and I am not adapting by hand

jobs.when: evidence is spread across systems and requests
jobs.want: one place that shows what has arrived and what is still open
jobs.so: I stop opening three systems to find one statement

jobs.when: I hand the file to the manager
jobs.want: the state of every sample and exception to travel with the file
jobs.so: I do not re-walk the work in the review

jobs.want: to check it in seconds against what it read
to reach the source of any claim in one action
jobs.so: I judge substance instead of hunting references

jobs.when: five engagements hit review in the same week
jobs.want: a queue with state across all of them
jobs.so: I clear what is waiting in the right order and notes stop looping

jobs.when: one step of delegated work is wrong
jobs.want: to correct that step without redoing the rest
jobs.so: I keep the work I trust and the history

jobs.want: the exception trail and the checkpoint record in the file
jobs.so: I can defend the file a year later

jobs.want: to know what it read and that a human approved anything restricted
the structure to fit the procedure in the first place
jobs.so: variants stop causing rework and quality findings

jobs.when: I set a data handling or checkpoint rule
jobs.so: teams do not have to remember it under pressure

jobs.when: I connect client systems to an engagement
jobs.so: no run can breach them without a per-document decision

opportunities.name: Find and assemble evidence without the hunt

solutions.name: Agent retrieval within data classes, with a log of what was read
solutions.experiment: Pilot telemetry: time from request to evidence in hand; usability task 'find what the agent read'

solutions.name: Agent chases open client requests
solutions.experiment: Pilot telemetry (M8): open-request age before and after agent chasing
solutions.why: Needs client-facing communication rules; independence review first (C2).

solutions.name: Extraction and matching against a typed structure, differences first
solutions.experiment: Time-and-motion step durations before and after; error count per sample in usability round 2

solutions.name: Fatigue-aware batching that pauses long sessions
solutions.experiment: Error position within session from telemetry
solutions.why: Solves a symptom S3 removes. Revisit if late-session errors persist in telemetry.

opportunities.name: Reach the source from any claim

solutions.name: Citation chip on every claim that opens the source at the span
solutions.experiment: Usability task: find the source for a claim, time and success

solutions.name: Full-text search across all engagement evidence
solutions.experiment: Search usage and success in pilot telemetry
solutions.why: Indexing across data classes needs the permission model first (C3). Returns in P5.

opportunities.name: Review with state and without loops

solutions.name: Review center: a queue with state and provenance in view
solutions.experiment: Review latency from draft to approval; notes per workpaper

solutions.name: Inline comments on the workpaper
solutions.why: Reproduces the note loop the research found (T5). Rejected on evidence, not on cost.

solutions.name: Exception workbench with mandatory human resolution
solutions.experiment: Exception resolution time; trust calibration measure

solutions.name: Agent-proposed exception resolutions
solutions.experiment: Acceptance rate of proposals in pilot
solutions.why: Every role named exception judgment as human work (T6). Independence (C2). Not a cost cut, a boundary cut.

opportunities.name: Keep state in the run across handoffs

solutions.name: The agent run and its timeline as the state holder
solutions.experiment: Pilot telemetry (M8): time between handoff and first action; usability round 2 handoff task (M11)

solutions.name: Structured handoff notes between roles
solutions.why: Notes are another place for state to live. S11 makes the run the place.

solutions.name: Typed field-structure library the planner targets
solutions.experiment: Rework causes by format in the review center; structure edits attempted

solutions.name: Templates for analytical procedures
solutions.experiment: Pilot on one area after Test of Details proves the pattern
solutions.why: Different agent reasoning (expectation forming). Prove the boundary pattern on Test of Details first (D-10, D-11). Returns in P5.

mvp_scope: Test of Details on two audit areas, revenue and payables, with the full run (plan, retrieve, extract, match, detect exceptions, draft conclusion), the review center and sign-off. No analytical procedures, no controls testing, no cross-engagement search, no agent-to-client communication.
mvp_areas_why: Area choice reconstructed. The two areas test opposite directions, existence for revenue and completeness for payables, so one agent behavior is exercised both ways before it extends. Which two areas the production MVP covered, and why, is for Yoni to confirm.

value.5: removes a high-consistency theme's pain for every role
value.3: removes pain for one role or one stage
value.1: nice to have, no theme behind it

feasibility.5: buildable with the design system as is
feasibility.3: needs one new pattern or a methodology ruling
feasibility.1: blocked by a constraint in 01 until a dependency ships

session_changes.what: Feasibility lowered from 4 to 3 by the engineering leads: 60+ structures must be typed before the planner can target them, so the library ships in batches by area. This is why only two areas made MVP.
session_changes.label: reconstructed

session_changes.what: Feasibility lowered from 4 to 3.5 by the engineering leads: the review center is a second surface with its own state; PMs kept it in MVP because T5 is where the deadline bites.
session_changes.label: reconstructed

session_changes.what: Moved from MVP to later after the methodology reviewer raised independence: an agent writing to a client is a C2 question before it is a feature.
session_changes.label: reconstructed

scope_cuts.name: Test of Details on inventory, cash and fixed assets
scope_cuts.why: Structures typed in batches by area (S13 feasibility). One agent behavior proved on two areas first (D-10). Return P3 to P5.

scope_cuts.name: Controls testing
scope_cuts.why: A different evidence model: operating effectiveness, not transaction tracing. Nothing in T1 to T14 touches it. Return after analytical procedures.
